item.title: Cast your vote for Vicksburg’s Mardi Gras Jester
item.description: Vicksburg is gearing up for a season of celebration, and one tradition the Vicksburg Convention Center implemented four years ago to add a bit of intrigue to its Mardi Gras Ball is the selection of a Mardi Gras Jester.

item.title: TEACHER OF THE YEAR: King strives to spark curiosity and build confidence
item.description: Brent King, a teacher and coach at Fresh Start, is a nominee for Educator of the Year. He said he strives to spark curiosity and foster confidence in his students.

item.title: St. Al's Brogdon explains decision to retire from coaching
item.description: St. Aloysius football coach Bumper Brogdon said his recent decision to retire was spurred by family considerations and a desire to enjoy life.

item.title: Stained-glass windows in Vicksburg churches tell stories of faith, history and light
item.description: Vicksburg’s churches reveal a tradition of stained-glass art, from Tiffany windows to simple colored panes, blending Bible stories, color symbolism and quiet spaces for reflection.

item.title: WHAT'S ON THE AGENDA: Board of Supervisors to hold meeting on Monday, Feb. 2
item.description: Below is the agenda for the Warren County Board of Supervisors meeting to be held on Monday, Feb. 2, at 9 a.m. at the Warren County Courthouse.

item.title: Sports Column: Vicksburg connections are deep in Super Bowl LX
item.description: Ernest Bowker is the sports editor of The Vicksburg Post. He can be reached at ernest.bowker@vicksburgpost.com

item.title: Warren County Records: Marriage licenses, warranty deeds, and deeds of trust from Jan. 21 to 27, 2026
item.description: Warren County recorded marriage licenses, warranty deeds, and deeds of trust from Jan. 21 to 27, 2026, detailing recent unions and property transactions across the area.

item.title: TEACHER OF THE YEAR: Moore customizes her lessons to suit students' needs
item.description: Warren Central Intermediate math teacher Dr. Denise Moore, a 16-year educator and Educator of the Year finalist, uses data-driven, hands-on lessons to meet each student’s needs.

item.title: ON THE SHELF: Murder, mystery and mountain lions in new Adult Fiction
item.description: This week’s column is more New Adult Fiction for your enjoyment.

item.title: Flashes, Lady Flashes turn eyes toward South State tournament
item.description: St. Aloysius' girls and boys teams have both qualified for the MAIS Class 3A South State tournament for the second year in a row.
